sections.content: This lesson introduces child directed play in a warm, supportive way. Many parents struggle with this area, and it is completely normal. You will learn why this topic matters, how it affects your child's development, and what you can expect to gain from the lesson.
sections.title: Welcome and Orientation

sections.content: This section explains the core ideas behind child directed play in simple, parent-friendly language. You will learn what the concept means, why it matters, how it affects your child's brain and behavior, and how stress or trauma can influence this area.
sections.title: Core Concepts

sections.content: Here you will find practical, step-by-step strategies for applying child directed play in real life. These skills are designed to be clear, doable, and supportive. You will get examples, scripts you can use with your child, and guidance for staying calm and consistent.
sections.title: Practical Skills and Strategies

sections.content: This activity helps you and your child practice child directed play together. It is simple, achievable, and designed to build connection. You will receive a guided exercise and a reflection prompt to help you notice what worked well.
sections.title: Parent Child Practice Activity

sections.content: This final section helps you integrate child directed play into everyday life. You will reflect on what you learned, choose one small action to try this week, and consider how the skill can support your family's wellbeing.
sections.title: Reflection and Integration
